dlg.forwardDelete.title: Delete forward
dlg.forwardDelete.body: Deleting immediately closes the forward's listener, active connections and new sessions. If the Agent is offline, immediate execution cannot be guaranteed and deletion is queued.
dlg.nodeDelete.title: Delete node
dlg.nodeDelete.body: Deleting the node stops all of its forwards and removes its configuration. An offline node completes cleanup when it reconnects.
dlg.forceDelete.title: Force delete node
dlg.forceDelete.body: Force delete removes the node from the UI immediately but does not wait for remote confirmation (remote_cleanup_confirmed=false). Residual remote state must be manually cleaned up.
dlg.forceDelete.queued: Force deletion queued; remote cleanup is not confirmed
dlg.navigationDelete.title: Delete navigation entry
dlg.navigationDelete.body: This removes the navigation entry from the public home. The linked Forward is not deleted.
